n1.speaker: doris
n1.text: You'll never believe it, Tom. The driver told me they're changing the number 42 route!

translations.fa: باورت نمیشه تام. راننده بهم گفت دارن مسیر ۴۲ را عوض می‌کنن!

branches.suggestion: Really? What exactly did he say?

n2.speaker: doris
n2.text: He said it wouldn't stop outside the library any more. He told me the new stop was by the petrol station.

translations.fa: گفت دیگه جلوی کتابخونه نمی‌ایسته. بهم گفت ایستگاه جدید کنار پمپ بنزینه.

branches.suggestion: That's quite far for you, Doris.

cultureNote.en: British vs American: petrol station (UK) = gas station (US).
cultureNote.fa: petrol station در بریتانیا یعنی پمپ بنزین.

n3.speaker: doris
n3.text: He said the council had decided it. Apparently they want to make the route faster. But I can't walk that far with my knees!

translations.fa: گفت شورای شهر تصمیم گرفته. ظاهراً می‌خوان مسیر را سریع‌تر کنن. ولی من با این زانوهام نمی‌تونم اون همه راه برم!

branches.suggestion: You should complain to the council.
branches.suggestionFa: باید به شورای شهر شکایت کنید.

n4.speaker: doris
n4.text: My neighbour said there was a meeting at the community centre on Thursday. She told me to bring a petition!

translations.fa: همسایه‌م گفت پنجشنبه یه جلسه تو مرکز محله هست. بهم گفت یه طومار بیارم!

branches.suggestion: I'll sign it. And I'll come with you.

n5.speaker: doris
n5.text: Seven o'clock. Oh, you're a love. Tom said he'd come too, didn't you, Tom?

translations.fa: ساعت هفت. آه، چه نازنینی. تام هم گفت میاد، مگه نه تام؟

branches.suggestion: We'll all go. They have to listen to us.
branches.suggestionFa: همه می‌ریم. باید به حرفمون گوش کنن.

branches.suggestion: Tom told me he'd drive us there.
branches.suggestionFa: تام بهم گفت ما را می‌رسونه.

n6.speaker: doris
n6.text: Marvellous! I'll make some flapjacks for the meeting. Nobody can say no to a flapjack!

translations.fa: عالیه! برای جلسه چندتا فلپ‌جک درست می‌کنم. هیچ‌کس نمی‌تونه به فلپ‌جک نه بگه!
